QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Kubinashi: Friend or Foe?
QuestInfo.0: Visit Kubinashi at the Mushroom Shrine and ask her to be your friend. If she doesn't kill you, she might say yes!
QuestInfo.1: Kubinashi asks you to bring Kamaitachi to the specified location at the decided time for a duel. You may need to be better friends with Kamaitaichi before he'll agree to do something like that...
QuestInfo.2: You relayed the message to Kamaitachi, but is it really okay to let the two of them fight?
